name: Hellkite skeleton
description: A dragon skeleton hung in the arena that the demon animates in the ritual, with a keystone plate connecting the ribs.

timeline.summary: Nira cushions Kaalia's fall as the spine snaps and the skeleton falls, killing the bald man.
timeline.quote: Nira twisted her body so she cushioned Kaalia's fall.
